description: Coastal Restoration Toolkit is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Restore America's Estuaries; NOAA Fisheries Office of Habitat Conservation. This site provides a simplified adaptation planning process. It includes information on five main areas of concern for coastal restoration: flooding, coastal erosion, water quality, invasive species, and wildlife habitat restoration. Each module provides a series of steps users can follow to construct their own adaptation plans. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Erosion and Shoreline Recession, Flooding – Coastal, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Wildfire. Assets: Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
